================================================================================
1. ORGANISATION OVERVIEW
================================================================================
Kleynenberg Software Ontwikkeling (KSO) is an independent Dutch R&D SME specializing in Artificial Intelligence, computational linguistics, parallel/browser-native compute, real-time sensor telemetry, and mission-critical systems architecture. Led by Founder & Principal AI Architect Steven Kleynenberg, KSO brings more than three decades of R&D leadership across academic research, enterprise software engineering, and European public-private innovation consortia.

================================================================================
2. CORE TECHNICAL CAPABILITIES
================================================================================
[CAPABILITY A] Sovereign AI & Hybrid Enterprise-RAG
- Privacy-by-design, on-premise, zero-vendor-lock-in retrieval-augmented generation.
- Deterministic linguistic pre-filtering (Part-of-Speech tagging, multi-word term extraction, sequence filtering) based on PCT Patent WO 2014/003543 A1 (https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2014003543A1/en) combined with dense vector search and local LLMs.
- High precision, explainability, and auditability for patent, regulatory, clinical, and enterprise knowledge bases.

[CAPABILITY B] Browser-Native AI, WebGPU & High-Performance Compute
- Zero-footprint client-side AI inference and parallel compute kernels built on WebGPU/WGSL shaders, WebGL, and Chrome Side Panel / Native Messaging bridges.
- Hardware-accelerated local speech synthesis/recognition and interactive visual neural network editors.
- Direct continuation of foundational research on neural network compilers and parallel neurocomputers (MetaNet and BSP400, 1990–1991).

[CAPABILITY C] Real-Time Sensor Telemetry, Edge-IoT & Decision Support (DSS)
- Physiological and environmental telemetry ingestion from Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) biometric sensors (Zephyr BioHarness, Polar H7), LoRaWAN/TTN gateways, and low-latency Linux DSP pipelines.
- Integration with deterministic rule-based Clinical and Operational Decision Support Systems (DSS) and interactive 3D/4D visual analytics (https://euro-scatter.netlify.app/).

[CAPABILITY D] Mission-Critical Systems & Sovereign Infrastructure
- Systems programming on Linux (C, C++, Python, Node.js, Apache C modules, embedded microcontrollers).
- Deterministic control loops, network resilience, strict attack-surface reduction, and automated forensic/security tooling.

================================================================================
3. EUROPEAN CONSORTIUM TRACK RECORD (ITEA & EU FP5)
================================================================================
- PARTNER (ITEA 3 16017): Award-winning European consortium on integrated clinical decision support and patient-centered care pathways.
- Medolution (ITEA 3 14003): Connected clinical telemetry and medical resolution architectures.
- MEDUSA (ITEA 2 10004): Medical Distributed Utilization of Services & Applications for acute stroke emergency workflows (peer-reviewed paper at ESOCC 2015).
- EDAFMIS (ITEA 2 07011): Enterprise Data & Federated Management Information Systems.
- LORE (EU FP5 IST-1999-12645): Linguistic retrieval and enterprise knowledge management.

================================================================================
4. ITEA 4 COLLABORATION AMBITION
================================================================================
KSO seeks consortium partnerships with European industrial enterprises, university medical centers, and research institutes in ITEA 4 calls focusing on:
1. Sovereign & Trustworthy AI
2. Edge & Browser-Native Intelligence
3. Hybrid RAG for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
4. Human-in-the-Loop Clinical & Operational Decision Support

Offered Contributions:
- End-to-end System & AI Reference Architecture Design
- Technical Work-Package Leadership
- Rapid Working Software Demonstrator & Prototype Engineering
